★ Request
Display Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi (Summer Gym Clothes)

...I give a wry smile at how ahead of myself I'm getting.
Thinking it's about time to sleep, I pick up my smartphone, and—

Just to be safe, she had an examination, but they said she didn't have a fever and nothing was wrong.
So when I asked why she had been so woozy—

The rest was written in wobbly handwriting.
"1. Eat meat regularly" "2. Ask regulars for tips"

Woooow, you beat your record again?! That's amazing, Tsurumaru-san!
And you only just joined the club, too!

—I can't let her carry all the weight alone.
Even if it's only provisional, I'm her Trainer too.

I quickly slip into bed. Alarm is set, too.
Now all I have to do is close my eyes...!
Owchies~, was what she said~.

I-I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!!
It's just, well, I woke up really early this morning...

Hhhnnnngh! I see, diet is super important for athletes too!
Nutrition and calories tie directly into building your body, after all!

Th-That was just me tripping over my own feet!
I'm totally fine! Totally fine! I even broke my fall properly!

(My plans with Trainer aren't until the afternoon.
So today...—)

If I've got talent, I have to polish it!
I need to put in way, way more... effort-tastic effort!
...Tsuru-chan-sama puts her heart and soul into everything she does, after all.

B-But my legs are plenty warmed up!
How about hitting the track right now?! I can sprint at full power starting from right here—

Tsuru-chan! Everyone's times are posted over there!
You wanna go check them out too, Tsuru-chan?!

Wah-wah-wahh?! Please don't worry about me.
I'm completely fine! Really!

Really?! Sorry, Coach, let's talk later!
Ummm, my time is—

...Is she still in bed right now, groaning in pain
while devising countermeasures all by herself? If that's the case—

Hehe... indeed.
Please be sure to share those feelings with Tsuru-chan-sama as well.

As the list went on, it turned less into strategies and more into sheer declarations of enthusiasm.
Yet every single line radiated Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's relentless optimism—
—I won't let this time go to waste either!

Next time, I'll shave off waaaay more!
After all, I'm the future Triple Tiara Umamusume!
I just thought I'd do, like, 50 laps for a warm-up...

No fever, and my legs don't hurt.
Well then, let's hit the outer track!
And I have also been entrusted with a letter for you~.

...Normally, I should send her right home to rest. But leaving her like
this didn't feel right either. The best compromise I could manage was—

Because everyone else must've been giving it their all too!
To begin with—I just haven't worked as hard as them!

And may I make one request of my own
as well?
Now's the time to show my grit. ...Tsuyoshi will challenge the absolute limits of her stomach.

—Boss, give me the Mega-Sized Special Heap-O'-Noodles!
Ten Umamusume-sized portions, pleeeeaaase!!

—But hey, studying race videos is something I can do at home!
I've got footage and books! Don't worry, there's plenty of ways I can do my best!

"Next time, I'll expand my stomach so I can finish every bite.
I came up with a strategy for that, too," she says~.
I mean, of course it is!!
Orowaaaah?!

I open the envelope I received from Mejiro Bright.
The first line read—"Operation: Tsuyoshi's 10 Bowls of Ramen!"

Individual training with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi starts tomorrow.
I hum to myself as I plan out what kind of regimen to put together.

I brought her to a ramen shop near the academy.
Talking about what comes next over a meal should help settle her nerves.
Hahi, hahe... augh... fuwaaaahhh............!

Zzz... zzz...
Ngh... mmm...

Ngh, gah?! Fuwaah...—
......Ah, it's 3 AM again...

"3. Become someone who can eat until full!"
"4. Grow into someone who'll blow Trainer away!"

*cough* *wheeze*! *cough* *hack*!
Whoaa, another fever... Guess I have to skip the club today...

...Dead last.
—...
Tsurumaru-san! Is your body—

...Ngh. Even if my legs hurt, I can still do shoulder stretches!
I'll get super flexible... The coaches are gonna be so amazed~♪
I trace my finger along the powerful resolve beneath the weak, spindly handwriting.

Mmmgh... ngh...... huh?
Huh... my bed...? Where am—...—Ha?!
Tsuru-chan-sama is resting today due to an upset stomach~.

...Without getting a wink of sleep, morning had arrived.
The air on the morning track is so crisp...
